summary: Comprehensive SEO meta tag testing for Google Search Console fixes. All 9 tested pages pass: unique titles, page-specific canonicals (not homepage), matching og:url and twitter:url, 'index, follow' robots, no duplicate canonical tags, correct hreflang for translated pages (6 tags) and non-translated pages (2 tags). Backend API /api/seo/page-meta returns correct data. Frontend inline script in index.html correctly sets all meta tags before React hydration.

minor.issue: Language-specific pages (es, de, fr, it) use fallback title generation instead of STATIC_META dictionary entries. The canonical is correct but titles are auto-generated from slug. This is acceptable as frontend inline script handles the actual meta tags.

index.html: Lines 206-232 - Hreflang logic correctly handles pages WITH translations (6 tags) and WITHOUT translations (2 tags: x-default, en)
